notes: No natural military event in C50; six qualified shared draws, expected hits 0.32731. D100: five qualified shared draws, one military founding. Sample insufficient for an incidence ratio.
No ordinary popular founding in these A/B/C/D samples. Court military participation is not monarch accession.
One final D world ends at 111, below the desired 120–150 band. Monthly peaks reach 156; there is no enforced hard cap or mass deletion.
Ordinary-zero annual observations are snapshots, not durations; a few occur around decline/extinction. No guarantee that every small polity always has troops.
75–95 year ordinary life plans derive from persisted user ID and birth month. Existing military and royal identities retain their authoritative lifecycle.
Population audit is session-scoped and resets on hydration. Royal map-unit and remnant changes are otherNet, not ordinary natural deaths.
An extra raw-loyalty cutoff was rejected after it changed the natural trajectory; it is absent from final code.
Siege crisis source is frozen before the transaction, so closing the siege during founding is not mistaken for absent original evidence.
Wall time and headless simulation timings are not user Chrome 4x visual acceptance.
